title: Catch-all Segment works as Optional Catch-all Segments inside the Parallel Route

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

labels.name: linear: next
labels.description: Confirmed issue that is tracked by the Next.js team.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/aramikuto/catch-all-inside-parallel-route-problem

### To Reproduce

1. Create a Catch-all Segment inside a Parallel Route.
2. Render the parallel route without adding any additional parameters.

### Current vs. Expected behavior

Current behavior:
The content of the Catch-all Segment is not rendered because it should not match empty parameters.

Expected behavior:
The content of the Catch-all Segment is rendered, and the type of the catch-all parameter is `undefined`.

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release
